page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, with the page number at the top right. Signature and catchword at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Harum autem perpetua & Universa praxis tot perspicuis & amplis in Scriptura Regulis pariter & Exemplis confona, cum satis oftendatur in Epistolis ad Timotheum & Titum co confilio scriptis, ad stabiliendum hoc maximè Regimen, non in personis duntaxat Timothei & Titi, sed in eorum etiam successoribus (cùm Disciplina & Regimine haud magis poflit Ecclesia quoad suum bene esse, quàm verbo, & Sacramentis quoad Esse, destitui) Miror illos, qui sic jus Episcopale & Authoritatem maligne intuentur, ita penitus livore occæcari, ut nec tantillum animadvertant, vel quis usus horum in Ecclesiâ, vel quàm fit Ἀποστολικὴ [?] constitutio, quod utrumque in his Epistolis videtur haud minus perspicuè explicari, (tanquam scopus earum esset & finis Principalis, ut peculiare quoddamMu-nus, Jus & Authoritas instituatur & delegetur certis hominibus, qui Præsidentes Episcopi, cæteris in Ordinatione, Censuris, & reliquis porrò Ecclesiasticæ Disciplinæ actibus praesent) quam breviores illæ notæ Qualitatum & Munerum ad Presbyteros, Episcopos, & Diaco-nos pertinentium, alibi in eadem Epistola describuntur. In latiori enim sensu & promiscuo usu Nominis, utrofque horum mos erat, (& fortasse nunc licet) appellare Episcopos, quatenus Curam quandam ipsi, & Infpectionem obtineant in Privatos suos Greges, quos illis Apostoli, vel Ἀποστολικοὶ [?] illi Episcopi de-

page.notes: Left margin: only damage and stains from the scan; no printed marginal text. Ἀποστολικὴ and Ἀποστολικοὶ: the first letter looks Greek on the scan and the rest is hard to read, so both are marked [?]. The word "teri" at the top is a fragment that continues from the previous page. The quoddamMu-nus join is as printed. Long s is written as a plain s throughout.
